svg.title: C16-M06-F1: Static and dynamic mobile testing
svg.desc: Static inspection of files versus dynamic testing of a running app, used together.
svg.text: C16-M06-F1 Static and dynamic mobile testing
STATIC : read manifest + config + code (no execution)
-> permissions, exports, cleartext, secrets, crypto, WebView
DYNAMIC : run on a controlled device/emulator
-> actual traffic (TLS?), runtime storage, logs, platform behaviour
static first (broad, safe); dynamic confirms runtime behaviour
Figure C16-M06-F1. Static inspection and dynamic testing are complementary [C16-M06-R2].
